start.speaker: Resident 1
start.text: Welcome to Paris. I am managing chores while living near the arch boulevard.

choices.text: How do local rules affect this task?
What is changing in this neighborhood?

rules.speaker: Resident 1
rules.text: At the house level we coordinate chores. City and neighborhood rules around zoning, quiet hours, and costs shape how easy that is in Paris.

change.speaker: Resident 1
change.text: People are adapting to policy trade-offs here: affordability, safety, and social norms. Around the arch boulevard, you can see those choices play out day to day.

end.speaker: Resident 1
end.text: Anytime. In this simulation, rules become incentives, and incentives become behavior.
